name: AIHubMix
description: Gateway with ten no-card trial calls before a top-up is needed for daily quotas.
overview: AIHubMix offers ten total trial calls across its zero-priced routes without a card. Ongoing daily quotas require a one-time $1 top-up. Listed per-model daily limits apply after that top-up, not to the no-purchase trial. Availability and pricing can change.
notes: Check the free-model page and account limits before use; no authenticated inference test performed.
